desc: Snacks for the nine types that had none (GARDEN_MODERN 8; Sound is chimebun in Care.FOODS). Care.FOODS adds these to the stall foods at load (Care._foods): name, desc, the numbers of a meal (food, joy) and price. The icon colour is the type's tint in lean.json (types[type].tint) and the type itself is lean.json foods[id], so a meal leans a Boki exactly as the existing type snacks do (Evo.eat: one FOOD_AFF for every food).
